Ivy Tan: Ping — NovaDrive says their May invoice token total is low. their SDK telemetry: 1,012,400 tokens; our export: 953,210. they reported a client-side spike on 2026-05-10 during a retry storm.
Ravi Kapoor: quick checks: did we roll any batching changes or header changes around 2026-05-09-11:00Z?
Sofia Gomez: We rolled a small change to the ingestion proxy that collapsed repeated identical requests into a single forwarded payload (de-dup at the proxy) to reduce load. It strips X-Idempotency in that path. sample proxy log lines: 
```
2026-05-10T11:03:12Z WARN proxy_dedupe collapsed req_id=nd-555 duplicates=3
2026-05-10T11:03:12Z INFO forward_ingest customer=novadrive forwarded_requests=1
```
Ivy Tan: Client insists each retry produced billable work on their side; they want a reconciliation and a credit if we undercount.
Ravi Kapoor: if proxy collapsed true duplicates before ingestion, our export is correctly lower. But we need to confirm clients didn't receive distinct 200 responses that they count as distinct billable events.
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): I can approve a provisional credit up to $150 while we investigate. NovaDrive is on a committed plan; keep escalation path open.
Sofia Gomez: Ops plan: (1) reconstruct by joining proxy logs with ingress and raw payloads for window 2026-05-10T10:30..12:00, (2) compute unique events by client_request_signature (X-Client-TS+payload_hash). ETA 8 hours.
Ivy Tan: please open ticket FIN-5067 and attach client telemetry. I'll message NovaDrive noting provisional credit and ETA.
Billing Bot: FIN-5067 created: NovaDrive potential undercount after proxy dedupe. Owner: Ivy Tan.
Ravi Kapoor: once backfill completes, finance will issue final adjustment and reverse provisional if necessary.
Ivy Tan: thanks — posting updates to FIN-5067.
